cards.back: Data handling, AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), anti-bribery.
Formal declaration confirming compliance status or fulfillment of an obligation.
Recorded confirmation that a person has read and accepted a policy.
Loss of trust and damaged brand image among customers, partners, and the public.
Fines, remediation costs, and lost revenue.
Lawsuits, mandatory notification, and executive liability.
Contract termination and contractual penalties with customers or vendors.
Regulatory or disciplinary sanctions against the entity or individuals.
Revocation of a certification or authorization to operate, such as the ability to process payments.
Right to obtain erasure of one's data when legal conditions are met.
Opt-in = explicit prior consent; opt-out = ability to decline or withdraw.
Rectifying inaccurate data; restricting or blocking processing that does not match consent.
Controller determines purposes and means; processor processes on its behalf per instructions.
Identifying the party that decides on the use and retention of the data.
Legal freeze that suspends destruction scheduled by the retention policy.
Authority orders requiring production, preservation, or disclosure of data.
Minimum or maximum retention periods defined by law, contract, or internal policy.
A legal hold or legal order always overrides the standard 30-day retention.
